expected_steps: divide by new number of workers
predicted_steps:
**Calculate the total amount of work required:**
    First, determine the total "worker-days" needed to build the wall.
    $$8 \text{ workers} \times 10 \text{ days} = 80 \text{ worker-days}$$
    This means the wall requires 80 units of labor to complete.

**Calculate the time for the new group of workers:**
    Divide the total work by the new number of workers (5).
    $$80 \text{ worker-days} / 5 \text{ workers} = 16 \text{ days}$$

**Answer:** 16 days.
